[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Replaces portraits for 20 vanilla NPCs.
- Uses the standard Content Patcher format.
- Includes portraits for Abigail, Alex, Caroline, Elliott, Emily, George, Gus, Haley, Harvey, Leah, Lewis, Marnie, Pam, Penny, Pierre, Robin, Sam, Sebastian, Shane, and Wizard.
- No original game files are overwritten.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Required:
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher

This mod is a Content Patcher content pack and will not work without Content Patcher.[/color]
